## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Mention task IDs and any changes
to physics, observations, actions or checkpoint compatibility.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Distinguish offline checks, GPU smoke
checks, policy evaluation and hardware testing; mark checks that were not run.

## Assets and dependencies

If applicable, describe submodule updates, third-party sources and licenses.
Keep generated weights, logs, local paths and credentials out of the diff.
